correctness.rationale: PASS: A selected edge set is open-packed iff the graph induced by all selected endpoints is the corresponding induced disjoint star forest. A T_n=L(K_n) vertex has a neighborhood composed of two cliques, hence selected star components have at most two leaves; chosen K2 and P3 in T_n correspond exactly to disjoint original 2-edge P3 and 3-edge P4 paths on respectively three and four labels. There are 3 and 12 undirected paths on each prescribed three/four labels. The labeled exponential formula yields exp(u+u³z/2+u⁴z²/2), coefficient n!/((n-3a-4b)! a! b! 2^(a+b)), and maximum degree floor(n/2)-1_{n≡2 mod4}; direct optimization of 3a+4b at fixed a+2b gives the stated piecewise leading coefficients, including n=0,1,2,3. Independently constructed T_n edges and their literal third-edge conflicts and exhaustively enumerated packing sets for n=3,4,5,6; coefficient profiles exactly agreed. These small cases corroborate, while the general bijection proves the all-n statement.

value.rationale: PASS: The all-cardinality edge-open-packing polynomial of the classical Johnson/triangular graph J(n,2) is a natural complete enumerative graph invariant. The disjoint short-path bijection explains its coefficient sequence, explicit recurrence, residue-class obstruction to maximal cardinality and coexistence of two maximizing block types when n≡2 mod4, n≥6. These precise facts are useful for comparing packing polynomials on line-graph families and are not just restatements of general induced-star definitions.

limitations: Only T_n=L(K_n)=J(n,2) for n≥0; not arbitrary line graphs or generic edge-in-triangle graphs.
Independent third-edge enumeration covered n=3..6; large n claims rely on combinatorial proof.
